from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashPosition(BaseModel):
    """Cash and cash equivalents reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the filing belongs to, as named")
    cash_line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label as written (e.g. 'Cash and cash equivalents', 'Cash and short-term investments')")
    amount_as_reported: float | None = Field(description="The cash amount as it appears in the document, without unit conversion")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document showing the cash line and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_positions: list[CompanyCashPosition]
